capabilities: Embed images as zoomable, pannable maps with multiple base and overlay layers
Place, edit, and organize markers, stickers, swap pins and icon libraries on maps
Measure distances with calibratable scale, units, and travel-time presets
Draw shapes and type text directly on map layers
Export SVG maps to WebP at 2k-12k resolution
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README says development is ongoing and points to a separate User Manual plus tutorial videos by Joshua Plunkett (obsidianttrpgtutorials.com); the README recommends re-checking it due to ongoing development.
problem: Obsidian can display images but has no way to turn one into an interactive map with placeable pins, layers, scale measurement and drawing for tabletop gaming.
summary: Interactive fantasy map tool that embeds images as zoomable, pannable maps with markers, stickers, drawings, measurements and text layers.
